name: The Deserter
description: A crumpled note in Outpost Balor's basement hints at someone in hiding. Find out who wrote it.

find_author.label: Find the Note's Author
find_author.description: Someone was hiding in Outpost Balor's basement. They mentioned catching 'the next train' — try Meridian City.

deliver_letter.label: Deliver Fen's Letter to Warden Holt
deliver_letter.description: Return to Outpost Balor and give Fen's letter to Warden Holt.

find_cache.label: Find the Squad's Supply Cache
find_cache.description: Search the deep perimeter east for Fen's squad's collapsed supply bunker, northeast of the main passage.

completionActions.text: You found Fen's squad's cache — military-grade equipment preserved in a collapsed bunker.

return_to_fen.label: Return to Fen Maro
return_to_fen.description: Tell Fen about the cache and their squad's last camp.

completionActions.text: Quest complete: The Deserter. Fen has made peace with their past and offers to serve as your guide.
